How to verify: Match IDs, hand, face, edge, grain, and revision before parts enter the assembly area.
Pass criteria: Every part belongs to the same released assembly and orientation.

How to verify: Inspect mating surfaces, machining, dust, damage, finish restrictions, and required relief.
Pass criteria: Each joint can close fully without force masking an error.

How to verify: Rehearse the order, clamps, cauls, drivers, cleanup, and hardware access before adhesive or permanent fasteners.
Pass criteria: The complete sequence fits the available open time and physical access.

How to verify: Check diagonals, dimensions, twist, reveals, movement, and labels before the assembly leaves the fixture.
Pass criteria: The assembly meets its downstream installation and finishing requirements.

How to verify: Lay out every component, loose panel, divider, back, stretcher, and hardware-dependent spacer.
Pass criteria: No missing or duplicated part is hidden by a partial fit.

How to verify: Seat joints using normal assembly force and inspect shoulders, bottoms, gaps, and trapped debris.
Pass criteria: Every joint reaches its intended stop without crushing or forcing.

How to verify: Measure exterior size, openings, diagonals, twist, and mating interfaces while dry.
Pass criteria: The assembly is adjustable into its released geometry.
